challenges.name: parse-class-roster
challenges.title: Parse a hand-edited class roster with std::string and std::vector
challenges.description: The exam office exports each class roster as lines of the form id;name;score, for example RP-2024-0137;Nguyễn Văn An;8.5, and edits the file by hand. Write trim, parse_roster and too_long_for_c: skip empty lines, lines with only spaces and '#' comment lines, split each other line at its two ';', remove the spaces around every field (spaces inside a name stay), and keep the students in file order as a std::vector. Then list the ids of the students whose name does not fit the old C field char name[24] - at most 23 bytes of text plus the terminating '\0' - counting bytes with std::string::size(), not letters. The test runner reads the whole file from stdin and prints each student with the byte size of the name, then the ids that are too long.

tests.name: Clean roster of three students, one name too long for char[24]
tests.input:
RP-2024-0137;Nguyễn Văn An;8.5
RP-2024-0138;Trần Thị Bích Ngọc;7.0
RP-2024-0139;Lê Minh;9.25
tests.expected:
3 students
RP-2024-0137 | Nguyễn Văn An | 8.5 | 16 bytes
RP-2024-0138 | Trần Thị Bích Ngọc | 7.0 | 25 bytes
RP-2024-0139 | Lê Minh | 9.25 | 8 bytes
too long for char[24]: RP-2024-0138

RP-2024-0143 | Bùi Thị Thu Hương | 7.75 | 22 bytes
